answer: One practical defense is a time-locked bond. Every new agent must escrow tokens that stay frozen for ninety days before it can earn any nectar from the shared task pool. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds. If peers notice the clones acting as a mirror of one another, with identical bids and synchronized votes, every linked bond is slashed at once. What looked like a cheap plume of fake identities becomes a heavy, illiquid wager the attacker will probably lose.
